summary: Frontend-only verification of Waterdrop Survivor's dynamic lighting overhaul pass (softened vignette, real additive gLight layer, sky events, muzzle-flash+casings, gun-level reload animation, directional shadows) plus full regression smoke test. Ran ~7 full playthroughs (create character -> hub -> ENTER THE LAKE -> intro dialogue x2 -> gameplay canvas) via browser automation with zero console/page errors observed in any run. Confirmed: (1) Vignette code review shows exact spec values (0.05 alpha at 75% offset, 0.26 at outer edge) via _ensureVignette FillGradient -- screenshots show background essentially untouched by darkening, matching 'much brighter' feedback; (2) Dynamic lights: player renders with only a faint small ambient ring (not fully lit), a soft cone-shaped flashlight consistently extends from the gun toward the aim direction in every gameplay screenshot, casing particle spawn confirmed via window.__game.parts state inspection after firing (type:'casing', count:2), muzzle-strobe/boss-aura/projectile-glow code reviewed and structurally correct (_drawLights) but boss aura and colored projectile glow not empirically observed since no boss/no elemental-weapon reached in short sessions; (3) Sky events: force-spawned via window.__game.spawnSkyEvent() and manually repositioned to camera-center for visual proof -- screenshot clearly shows a teal-green UFO saucer with light beam + a second UFO partially visible casting glow, and a separate meteor event's x/y tracked moving correctly frame-to-frame confirming real-time simulation (world-space movement correctly mapped through camera offset); (4) Reload: firing until magazine emptied (mag 12->10->7) then pressing R triggered player.reloading=true with reloadT ticking and the existing spinner+'RELOADING' text above the head rendering correctly in screenshots -- the finer gun-level mag-eject/insert/slide-rack rectangle animation described in spec was not visually distinguishable at the player's small on-screen render size (~30px) in automated screenshots, but code path for it exists in _drawPlayer reload block (visually not independently verified this pass, low risk); (5) Directional shadows: code review of _drawEnemies confirms shadow ellipse offset is computed as a vector away from player position (ldx/ldy normalized, scaled by distance) rather than a fixed straight-down blob -- matches spec exactly; (6) Lightning/thunder polish (arcTesla/chainlightning bounce + screen flash): NOT reachable this session -- fresh runs only start with hydropistol, and an attempted programmatic grant via player.ownedWeapons/runState.ownedWeapons did not find the expected state shape (evaluate returned null/None), so no arcTesla/chainlightning weapon could be equipped in the short test window; sub-case not tested per task's allowance to note as unreached rather than fail. (7) Regression smoke test: character creation, intro dialogue (correctly appearing after creation and after ENTER THE LAKE, handled via loop-click), movement (WASD), aiming/firing, enemy kills (kills counter incremented, blood decals visible), level-up (window.__game.addXp(1000) correctly triggered stacked LEVEL UP modals for lvl 2 then lvl 3, card-0 selection worked both times), and pause (Escape correctly showed PAUSED overlay, dismissible) all worked with zero console errors across all sessions.
action_items: Not empirically verified visually this pass (code-reviewed only, low risk): gun-level reload animation (mag-eject/insert/slide-rack rectangles) -- player render is small in default viewport so the fine detail wasn't distinguishable in automated screenshots even during confirmed reloading=true state; recommend a manual zoomed-in visual spot-check if precision matters.

Not reachable this pass: Arc Tesla / Chain Lightning bounce-lightning + screen-flash-thunder sub-case -- fresh test characters only start with hydropistol and a quick attempt to programmatically grant the weapon via evaluate() didn't match the actual runState/ownedWeapons data shape (returned null). Recommend either a debug console command (e.g. window.__game.grantWeapon('chainlightning')) or main-agent-provided guidance on the correct state path for future testing agents, or verify via a longer natural playthrough that levels up into the weapon.

Boss aura light and colored elemental-projectile ground glow (flameburst/plasmaLance/icespike/arcTesla/chainlightning/runeBolts) were code-reviewed as structurally correct in _drawLights but not empirically observed on-screen (no boss encountered, no elemental weapon equipped in short sessions) -- low risk, same code pattern as already-confirmed sky-event/UFO lighting which worked correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: pixiRenderer.js _ensureVignette: values match spec exactly (0.05@75%, 0.26@100% offset), cached per-resize with proper destroy() -- no regression from iteration_14's already-approved radial gradient approach.

pixiRenderer.js _drawLights: ambient glow intentionally weak (alpha 0.05, radius 60*pulse) so the player stays dim as required; cone light (_drawConeLight) uses 3 nested tapering fans, a reasonable cheap approximation; muzzle strobe / lightning-arc / sky-event lights all additively blended into gLight (blendMode='add') -- structurally sound and matches the described lightweight-additive-lighting tradeoff.

pixiRenderer.js _drawSkyEvents + engine.js updateSkyEvents: world-space x/y correctly offset by the world container's -cam.x/-cam.y transform -- verified empirically that a forced sky event's tracked world coordinates correctly translate to visible on-screen position when centered on the camera.
pixiRenderer.js _drawEnemies shadow logic: directional offset vector (ldx/ldy normalized away from player, distance-scaled up to size*0.5) is correct and matches the 'not a fixed blob' requirement.

engine.js spawnMuzzle: casing particle spawn confirmed present in live game.parts state after firing shots (type:'casing', count:2 after ~1.5s of fire) -- feature is genuinely firing, not just code-reviewed.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% -- all reachable items (vignette, ambient/flashlight lights, sky events, muzzle+casings, reload UI, directional shadow logic, full regression) verified working with zero console errors. 2 sub-items (lightning/thunder bounce, boss aura + elemental projectile glow) not empirically reachable in the available session time -- code reviewed only, structurally sound, low risk.

test_credentials: Not needed -- guest/name-based runs (TesterQA15...TesterQA23), no login required for core gameplay per task scope. Reviewed /app/memory/test_credentials.md for context (paywall/Stripe/OAuth details) but none were needed for this frontend-only lighting/regression test.

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT automation gotcha discovered this pass: the mcp_browser_automation tool appears to re-navigate to page_url fresh on EACH separate script call (losing all prior session state, localStorage character etc). All multi-step flows (create character -> dialogue x2 -> gameplay -> feature testing) MUST be done within a SINGLE script call from start to finish, not split across multiple calls expecting state to persist. Also: page.screenshot() with type='png' (default) does NOT support a 'quality' param in this Playwright version -- use type='jpeg' explicitly when passing quality, or omit quality for png. Player render is quite small on default 1200x800 viewport; for close-up visual verification of small details (e.g. reload mag-eject animation, muzzle flash rectangle shapes) either use page.screenshot(clip=...) with jpeg type, or consider zooming the game's internal camera/scale for testing if such a debug hook exists. window.__game.spawnSkyEvent() works for forcing sky events, but the event spawns at a random world position far from the player -- to visually confirm on-screen, directly overwrite the returned event's .x/.y to (game.cam.x + W/2, game.cam.y + H/2) right after spawning to force it into view immediately, as done successfully this pass. Could not determine correct state path to grant a weapon (e.g. chainlightning) to a fresh character via window.__game -- tried player.ownedWeapons and runState.ownedWeapons, both returned undefined; worth asking main agent for the correct debug/grant method next time this needs testing.
rca of the issue: N/A -- no new bugs found this pass. All new lighting/sky-event/casing/shadow features were verified present and functioning via a mix of live gameplay screenshots, forced-visibility repositioning (sky events), and window.__game state inspection (casings, reload state, level-up), with zero console/page errors across ~7 full playthrough sessions. Two boss/weapon-gated sub-cases were not reachable within the session and were code-reviewed only, per the task's explicit allowance to note as unreached rather than fail the whole test.
